results: Requirement F15 fully implemented: UI displays policy revision and explains changed decision using fixture context in apps/web/src/pages/Simulator.tsx.
Revision comparison headers and transition status badges (DENY -> ALLOW, ALLOW -> DENY, UNCHANGED) clearly delineate baseline vs candidate policy outcomes.
Accessible decision comparison table features caption, column/row scopes, and evaluates outcome, revision, digest, target resource, and classification attributes.
Decision diff explanation card synthesizes subject identity, roles, target resource, and policy rule reasons to explain the root cause of changed decisions.
Loopback HTTP endpoint /api/v1/runtime/simulate wired into Node supervisor proxy (scripts/serve-web.mjs) and verified against engine handler (cmd/policyhelix/main.go).
Script and HTML sentinel inertness verified: no script execution or DOM XSS occurs, all content renders inertly with HTML escaping.
Mobile responsiveness at 360px width verified with zero horizontal scroll (scrollWidth <= innerWidth).
Keyboard accessibility verified across dropdown, file upload, action buttons, and comparison tables.
Fail-closed behavior verified for unauthenticated private resources, engine outage (503), malformed JSON, and empty states.
Seven Apache-2.0 synthetic fixtures cataloged with SHA-256 digests in tests/fixtures/policyhelix/C21/manifest.json.
Go regression test suite (tests/simulator_ui_test.go) and Playwright browser test suite (apps/web/tests/simulator.spec.ts) provide automated verification.
